messages:
sophia: Quick sync — I'm going to run a canary of model v3.2-int4 tomorrow morning. Proposal: do a biased-slice bisection (prioritize slices with known sensitivity), then binary split within the offending slice to find the minimum traffic that triggers regression. Auto-fallback decision tree attached. Looking for comments on metrics and thresholds.

ravi: metrics first — which signals do we use for 'regression'? latency p95, hallucination rate (QA eval), and user-quality NPS?

sophia: plan is p95 latency, token-cost delta, and two fidelity signals: rouge-like similarity on benchmark prompts + a small eval set hallucination count. Hallucination will be weighted higher.

aj: suggest we formalize the bisection steps. Quick pseudo: 
```
1) split traffic to slice S (biased) at 20% -> run 30m
2) if delta_metric > warn_thresh -> binary split S into S1/S2 at 10%/10%
3) continue bisect until bucket size == min_slice or metric delta stabilizes
4) run auto-fallback if delta > critical_thresh for 3 consecutive windows
```
Add short circuit for infra errors.

maya: sampling sizes: for low-volume slices we should increase sample window to 2h. warn_thresh = 3% relative, critical_thresh = 7% relative for fidelity signals. For latency, warn=+40ms p95, critical=+120ms.

sophia: good baseline. also adding a soft-fallback before full fallback: drop to quantized-compatible variant (v3.1-int8) for 15m then re-evaluate.

eva: +1 to soft-fallback. Also we should require manual approval to promote again if critical_thresh was hit. Otherwise we risk flip-flopping.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary start: 2026-03-22T09:00Z; estimated duration 6h. Notifying on-call.

sophia: here's the decision tree snippet i'll put in the runbook: 
```
if fidelity_delta >= critical_thresh or hallucination_increase >= critical_count:
  - trigger immediate full fallback -> route all traffic to stable variant
elif fidelity_delta >= warn_thresh:
  - bisect slice and run shadow compare
  - if repeated warn windows (n>=3) -> soft-fallback to compatible variant
elif latency_p95_increase >= latency_critical:
  - trigger autoscale + slow-traffic-route to lower-latency pool
else:
  - continue gradual ramp
```

ravi: we should log which exact prompt slices triggered the bisect steps (hash + seed) so we can repro. Also add automated issue creation if soft-fallback is triggered.

maya: agree. I'll add a small eval harness to run the offending prompts offline against v3.2-int4 and v3.1-int8 and surface top-5 differences in the runbook UI.

sophia: final checklist before go: 1) thresholds in config, 2) alerting to #incidents and oncall, 3) repro artifacts auto-upload, 4) manual promo lock if critical fallback happened. Any blockers?

aj: none from infra side. confirm the min_slice size (5%?) and the minimum traffic window (30m/2h conditions).

sophia: min_slice = 2.5% for high-volume routes, 5% for mid, and for low-volume we use min time window instead. I'll post the full runbook after the dry run.

eva: thanks — please include a quick rollback playbook for customer-facing incidents (who pings legal/support).

sophia: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
